label: Load-test headline
context: The first performance headline on the homepage. Reports the highest rate tested, not maximum capacity.

label: Load-test result
text: 95% of cached HTML responses completed within 20 ms, with zero errors.
context: Appears directly below the load-test headline. Describes the observed 95th percentile and error count at the peak stage.

label: First-render headline
context: The second performance headline. Refers to first content appearing, not complete page load.

label: First-render result
text: First content appeared in 168 ms on CARLOS versus 758 ms on Classic, averaged over five visits each.
context: Appears below the first-render headline. Gives the two measured averages from five fresh visits per page.

label: Load-test method
text: Measured on 24 October 2026 from one machine, using normal URLs and persistent HTTP connections. The load test increased in twelve-second stages to 320 requests per second. At that rate, the cached Tito page returned 3,839 responses with no errors and a 19.7 ms 95th-percentile response time.
context: Always-visible measurement notes below the claims. Gives the date, scope, duration and exact peak result.

label: Browser-test method
text: First Contentful Paint measures when content first appears. We averaged five alternating desktop Chromium visits to each AwesomeConf page: Classic and CARLOS. Each visit used a fresh browser context with browser caching disabled and no network throttling. Server-side page caching stayed enabled.
context: Always-visible browser measurement notes. Explains the first-render measurement and browser setup.
